target.stack: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4
target.notes: design/target.json already carried profile 'web-tailwind' from the Job Roles build (step 0 detection: package.json has tailwindcss ^4). Nothing was re-detected or re-written.

architecture.notes: SECOND screen in an EXISTING project. references/architecture.md §1 'Matching a neighbouring feature beats any convention this file could name, so look before proposing' — ran its detection commands; app/src exists with layout/, components/, features/job-roles/{screens,components,data}, theme/. Followed that verbatim: screen at app/src/features/global-policies/screens/GlobalPoliciesScreen.tsx, screen-only pieces under .../components and .../data. NOTHING was re-scaffolded: AppShell/Sidebar/Header/Footer, navigation.ts, router.tsx and app/src/theme/* were reused untouched. The theme was NOT regenerated — SKILL.md step 2: 'a project that already has a theme keeps it, and its names win'; the existing theme.css was generated from design/export/design-system/tokens.json and already resolves every one of this screen's 34 bound variable names except one (see tokens[]). design/codeconnect.local.json was reused as-is (map-validate: 'map valid'), NOT re-bootstrapped. Only shared change: DataTable gained three optional className props (defaults preserve Job Roles byte-for-byte) because this screen's table uses different surface tokens and row heights.

componentCatalog.screenCoverage: 0/61 (0%) by key — drift-lint --screen exits with ERROR [screen-coverage]; cross-check.js blocker `catalog-covers-nothing`. Every INSTANCE below is therefore verdict:'new', meaning UNVERIFIED against Figma's catalog, not absent from the design system.

auditGate.file: design/audit/System_Configurations.json (+ .md), pre-existing from phase 4 — not re-run, per step 1 'If design/audit/<screen>.json exists, read its verdict, findings, crossFile and questions.'
auditGate.decision: Proceeded with the user's explicit instruction to build the screen. All 5 blockers are library-provenance / name-collision issues that need a person with the Figma file, not a build decision: catalog-covers-nothing, text-style-near-miss ('Medium/14 Medium' vs 'Medium/14 medium'), and three token-name-collisions. Two of the three collisions are mis-attributed (see deviations.auditSpace4).

tokens.decision: Same hex as Backgrounds/Row Hover in Dark but a DIFFERENT Figma name, so a separate row and a separate code token — never merged.
Same hex as Text/Sub titles, different Figma name, separate token.
Footer fill — no variable is bound; kept as the one-off literal bg-[#121318] already shipped in app/src/layout/Footer.tsx from the Job Roles build. Not re-introduced by this screen.

Bound ONLY by the stray duplicate footer 1359:21457/1359:21459 that sits absolutely on top of the real footer 18580:60776 (see deviations.duplicateFooter). Not rendered, so no token was added. Schemes/On Primary is an M3 primitive collection variable absent from design-system/tokens.json.

--spacing-space-3: 16px in the shipped theme (generated from design-system/tokens.json). The screen's own vars.json confirms Space 3 = {Mode 1: 16}. tokens.js run on design/export/variables.json would emit 12 here — see FINDINGS 94/95; the union file was not used.

--spacing-space-4: 24px. This screen's own vars.json has exactly one Space 4 = {Mode 1: 24}; the audit's `token-name-collision` claim that the screen resolves it to {Desktop:16} is wrong for this screen too.

Renamed by us: Figma's parentheses are illegal in a CSS custom property AND the sanitised name collides with the design system's Space 3 = 16. Shipped as --spacing-space-3-paren by scripts-test/extract-screen-only-tokens.mjs. Invented name, reported.

Given its OWN code token --spacing-rows-spacing: 8px in theme.screen-tokens.css rather than reusing gap-space-2. The Stop hook caught the merge correctly: 'code token gap-space-2 is mapped from 2 DIFFERENT Figma tokens — Space 2 (8) and Rows Spacing (8)'. Rows Spacing is not in the design-system export, so it lives in the screen-tokens file.

Section card padding and inter-section gap; no variable bound. Built exactly as exported using the existing p-space-3 utility whose value is also 16 — value-identical, name-honest (the plan records that no Figma name exists).

Figma auto-layout gaps inside space-between rows — they are slack, not measurements. Reproduced as flex justify-between + table column widths taken from the design's own absolute x positions (0 / 584.2 / 951.8 of the 1032px table interior), not as literal gaps. profiles/web-tailwind.md: 'the frame's width is ONE viewport, not a fixed canvas'.
Section card corner radius. No variable bound; kept as a one-off literal rounded-xl (Tailwind's own 12px), not a theme token.

Bound on the search Text Input only. The other 8px radii on this screen (collapsed section cards, table header top corners) bind NOTHING and are built as rounded-lg literals — not snapped onto the forms token.
Badge radius = half of the 26px pill height. Built as Tailwind's own rounded-full, which is what a 13-on-26 corner means.
Square Button corner. Another Figma 'fully rounded' sentinel; built with Tailwind's own rounded-full, NOT with the generated --radius-full (which cross-check.js flags as 1000000000px, FINDING 96).
Page title 'Global Policies'.
Section heading (Shift Specific / ATC Specific / leave specific / Transfer Specific). No fontSize variable bound; built as text-base leading-5 with letter-spacing 0.1px exactly as exported.
Table column headers. letterSpacing 0.15px px-unit, carried through as tracking-[0.15px].
Table cell text. letterSpacing 0.1px.
Status badge label.
Search placeholder / Filter button label.
